title: 035 GBR extension: the new-input screen on GBR (NNNC_GbbRaw_Open, plain LSTM on 8 raw-price features)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era. Nothing adopted.
control_sizer: cs_gbr (NNNC_CS_GBR: WidthSizerMixin p_buy + NNNC_W_GBR; keys equal fs_gbr_gr on 15 folds)

reproduce.note: measured before this commit from cs_gbr's f00-f07 picks (all verified, 0 tag mismatches); no input read

s1b.sample: first bar of each run of width_twin._gates (gbb rule + control guards, NO width cut), per pair, entry bar inside the fold test window, quote volume >= 1000 (the simulator's MIN_QV)
s1b.sample_note: identical bars to S1b-ARO (gates and exits depend only on price columns and shared settings); only the control p_buy differs (GBR's)
s1b.outcome: net profit ratio of a trade entered at the next bar's open and exited by the 24 h grace control's exits (paths.replay, as the width-book simulator), without occupancy, wallet or max-open limits
s1b.statistic: partial Spearman of input with outcome given bb_width and GBR p_buy

s2.model: NNNC_GbbRaw_Open + one input as a pre-normalised column (raw8 scaler main_scaler_fwdmae_raw8 unchanged)
s2.pass: early gap > BOTH references (i.e. > 0.063) with <= 2 of 8 folds degenerate; winner = largest gap
s2.why_both: GBR's at-share gap (0.0128) is far below its own-decision gap (0.063, 033); requiring both, as 034's S1, keeps the bar comparable to ARO's

s3.arm: cs_gbr with only the weights changed, all 15 folds
s3.pass: judge_one(arm, cs_gbr) PASS AND judge_one(arm, w_gbr) PASS; fs_gbr_gr reported
s3.note: cs_gbr itself has no records yet; it is picked on f08-f14 and backtested on 15 folds only if S3 is reached

disclosed: S1b-ARO read: survivors MS_VR, MS_BV, OF_TRG; S2-ARO read: no winner (gaps 0.034-0.044 vs 0.1003)
the S1b-GBR sample and outcomes are the same bars as S1b-ARO; only the control p_buy changes
the GBR control-at-share gap (0.0128) and own-decision gap (0.063) were measured before this commit
